✓ Boundary Bay Airport.fact: When the armed forces was unified in 1968, the station's name changed to CFS Ladner. The station eventually closed in 1971 due to the installation of nearby power lines in Ladner that made gathering signals difficult.

✓ Boundary Bay Airport.question: As of 2010, _____ ceased operations but the FBO is open serving business, corporate, and general aviation customers
✓ Boundary Bay Airport.fact: In April 2008, Alpha Aviation set up a fixed-base operation (FBO) and Alpha Executive Air began operating regularly scheduled flights twice daily between Boundary Bay Airport and Victoria International Airport on Vancouver Island, as well as chartered aircraft services. As of 2010, Alpha Executive Air ceased operations but the FBO is open serving business, corporate, and general aviation customers.
